name: Mizpah
brief: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment
short: Mizpah (Mizpeh, Ramah, Ramathaim-zophim, Arimathea), a city in Benjamin where the Israelites gathered for judgment and prayer (<ref="Judges 20:1, 3; 21:1, 5, 8; 1Sa.7.5-7, 11-12, 16; 10:17">Judges 20:1, 3; 21:1, 5, 8; 1Sa.7.5-7, 11-12, 16; 10:17</ref>), and the hometown of Samuel (<ref="1Sa.1.19; 2:11; 7:17; 8:4; 15:34; 16:13; 19:18-23; 20:1; 25:1; 28:3">1Sa.1.19; 2:11; 7:17; 8:4; 15:34; 16:13; 19:18-23; 20:1; 25:1; 28:3</ref>) and Joseph of Arimathea (<ref="Matthew 27:57; Mrk.15.43; Luke 23:50-51; Jhn.19.38">Matthew 27:57; Mrk.15.43; Luke 23:50-51; Jhn.19.38</ref>).
